episodes.title: The Man With Loan Shark Debts
episodes.summary: As the debtor faces imminent danger from his loan shark, he enlists Jang Gil Ryong for a diabolical task — one that comes at a high and personal cost.

episodes.title: The Man Who Disposed of a Body
episodes.summary: Distracted by Lee Yoo Jung, Glasses gets into a car accident. When he discovers a witness, he panics and tries to erase any trace of his involvement.

episodes.title: The Unrighteous
episodes.summary: After the witness demands more money, Glasses uncovers inconsistencies in the recent accident. The Debtor panics as Gil Ryong demands his due.

episodes.title: The Woman Trapped in the Past
episodes.summary: Caught in the shadows of her past, Lee Joo Yun is stirred by a name that echoes old memories, pushing her to confront lingering questions.

episodes.title: Rewind
episodes.summary: Prepared with a plan, the Debtor confronts Gil Ryong — but the plot soon devolves into chaos when the Witness sees an opportunity to exploit.

episodes.title: Karma
episodes.summary: The Witness faces unexpected setbacks after thinking he's in the clear. But with Joo Yun on his trail, can he break free from the relentless karmic cycle?
